author: 12hrs
quote: Releasing this game on consoles was a huge mistake. They do the same thing with every new release, bending over for consoles and kissing their a*ses. This game deserved to be built for PC. From the 30 FPS issue to all the graphical shortcomings, there are so many flaws and missing details that jump out at me. I don’t even want to waste my energy going into detail about everything wrong with this game.
